description: ANEEL open data portal is a data repository run by Agência Nacional de Energia Elétrica (ANEEL), found in the Americas country search of 2026-09-30. Electric energy distribution and transmission data: distributor tariffs, generation information (SIGA), transmission management (SIGET) and regulatory complaints, downloadable in CSV, XML and PARQUET through a CKAN catalogue. Coverage: Brasil. The homepage answered on 2026-09-30; its title reads "Bem-vindo - Portal de Dados Abertos - Agência Nacional de Energia Elétrica". Text above taken from the homepage (page summary); the data pages behind it were not opened. It is reached through the link recorded on this page. Access to the repository is free of charge and open; individual data sets may carry their own conditions. The licence is set per dataset in the repository (not stated on the homepage). Caveats: only the homepage was read, so the data sets behind it, their formats, their licences and their current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support finding infrastructure and hazard data of Brasil.
